300018.phrase: Engaging with government regarding the priorities of the Saskatchewan Association of Optometrists including scope of practice and the implementation of The Regulated Health Professions Act.
Engage with the government regarding the implementation of the Regulated Health Professions Act (RHPA) and a range of policies that impact the dental profession.
